policy.authored: Edit directly and review as Espframe source.
policy.generated: Edit the listed sources and regenerate; never hand-edit outputs.
policy.vendored: Update only from the recorded upstream revision and retain its license plus local-change notes.
policy.external_build_asset: Fetched only while building and must have a recorded upstream and license.

vendored.name: Noto Sans and Rubik native glyph atlases
vendored.revision: Stock ESPHome Noto Sans weight 325 (SHA-256 cfffc3ecf6aaa6a205b16c68070cceca472208a06581e6f131cdd0294913d900), weight 400 (SHA-256 5be701a9511117e73603bdab95947feef4f18bd1851dbddc30659370b26c69f1), stock Noto Sans Hebrew 3.001 weight 400 from the Noto Hebrew project (SHA-256 a5cc5ce90ed4f6393992728fcc63657c4dd83aed119acbd5f4ed223e40c71129), and Noto Sans Regular 2.015 for recovery (SHA-256 f5f552c8c5edb61fe6efb824baf4d4de47b1a8689ab4925ff43f7bd6a4ebece5)
vendored.local_changes: The clock uses 150-pixel Rubik at weight 300, centred in fixed digit slots. Photo captions use 28-pixel Rubik at weight 400, with Noto Sans at weight 400 for location glyphs missing in Rubik. The date atlas covers the month and relative date strings in product/translations. firmware/native/tools/rasterize_clock.py generates the glyphs and Gaussian-blurred shadow masks for the clock and photo captions. firmware/native/tools/rasterize_status.py generates 26-pixel localized status lines from the recorded Noto Sans faces. The Wi-Fi recovery credential glyphs are 26 pixels. The firmware embeds 4-bit masks and has no font runtime dependency.

vendored.name: ESPHome captive portal and setup page
vendored.revision: 2026.9.1; portal decoded from that revision's captive_index.h
vendored.license: GPL-3.0 for C/C++; MIT for Python and the esphome-webserver page
vendored.local_changes: Use an IPv4 AP DNS socket independently of station IPv6 and clear counts for omitted DNS sections, style the setup and WiFi-saved confirmation pages with the shared Espframe webserver stylesheet while preserving upstream provisioning behavior and preventing network-link navigation, match EspControl's no-cache response policy, and expose the captive portal domain for ESPHome's web server validation. Page source and generated encodings are documented in README.md; the page's MIT license is in PORTAL_LICENSE.

vendored.name: Remote Image ESPHome component
vendored.revision: Project-maintained derivative; original import revision is not preserved
vendored.local_changes: Renamed component with JPEG/WebP decoders, reliability fixes, buffer controls, direct RGB565 WebP decoding for matching opaque buffers, and Espframe display behavior.

vendored.name: ESPHome MIPI DSI display component
vendored.license: GPL-3.0-or-later for C/C++ and MIT for Python
vendored.local_changes: Value-initialize the DSI PHY clock source so ESP-IDF selects the silicon-appropriate default for production ESP32-P4 v3.x and earlier revisions. Add an optional double_buffer mode that renders into a hidden frame buffer and swaps at the panel frame boundary to prevent tearing, and an optional frame_transitions mode that composites photo transitions with the PPA, releasing transition-only buffers if setup fails and limiting blend DMA bursts so scanout can access PSRAM. Used by all JC8012P4A1 profiles.
